items.title: test(crabbox): preserve schemas and lazy fixture loading
items.summary: test(crabbox): preserve schemas and lazy fixture loading Commit 0508a6d22f560 made the managed-binary error formatter a runtime import, pulling logging and canonical SQL reads into relocated fixtures. The esbuild fixtures omitted schema inlining, so reads targeted missing .tmp SQL files. Their monolithic 74 MB bundle also exceeded lifecycle readiness deadlines when TSX processed its dynamic imports. Reuse the canonical schema inliner in all three fixture builds. Preserve lazy imports with code splitting, relocate and clean exact compiler outputs, and load compiled JavaScript behind the real TSX entrypoint. Production code, deadlines, assertions, and mocks remain unchanged. A15: scheduled CI run 37116831255 at 10bddffa349e. Before: 264 failed, 7 passed, 1 skipped. Final full replay: 270 passed, 1 skipped, 1 unresolved transport rejection timeout at the existing 10-second child deadline (observed 11.659 seconds). Missing-schema and all lifecycle regressions pass. Do not treat the full file as green. Fresh-checkout wrapper --help, changed-file gate, and independent review passed. Latest remote main 5f52ff0f863c5 has no equivalent fixture fix. Test cost: 924.59s wall for node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/crabbox-wrapper.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 (OPENCLAW_VITEST_NO_OUTPUT_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000).

items.title: CISA警示FortiMail漏洞CVE-2026-104286已遭實際利用
items.summary: 美國網路與基礎設施安全局（CISA）維護的已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），10月1日新增CVE-2026-104286，這是存在Fortinet郵件安全閘道設備FortiMail的路徑遍歷漏洞，聯邦政府各民事執行單位須在10月4日前完成修補。

items.title: Chrome 154本週第二度發布更新版，緊急修補11個漏洞
items.summary: 9月29日Google發布Chrome瀏覽器的154.0.8037.92版或154.0.8037.93版，修補32個漏洞，兩天後又緊急推出更新版本，目前針對Windows平臺與Mac平臺的Chrome提供154.0.8037.97版或154.0.8037.98版，針對Android平臺的Chrome提供154.0.8037.126版，至於Linux平臺的Chrome，則是預計在後續幾天或幾週推出154.0.8037.97版，當中總共修補11個漏洞。
